sections.label: THINKING
sections.content:
Wait — only 8 actions were executed (SPACE, DOWN, LEFT×5, UP), not 9. The last RIGHT wasn't executed? The message says "已执行动作：SPACE, DOWN, LEFT, LEFT, LEFT, LEFT, LEFT, UP" — 8 actions. So my batch of 9 was... hmm, maybe the action list got truncated? Or the 9th (RIGHT) wasn't executed. Whatever.
Current state:
- Player: W 4 [[32,12],[32,15]] = row 32, cols 12-15; N 12 rows 33-35, cols 12-15. So the body is rows 32-35, cols 12-15, facing up (white edge on top).
- Left eye: frame c rows 28-31, cols 16-19 intact; core rows 29-30, cols 17-18.
- New: c 12 [[28,32],[28,35],[31,35],[31,32]] — a charcoal frame has appeared at rows 28-31, cols 32-35! That's the mouth-center region! The nose frame regenerated at the mouth position?? Wait, the nose frame was originally at rows 36-39, cols 32-35. Now there's a c frame at rows 28-31, cols 32-35 — that's where the arm/body was when it pushed the core into the mouth. Hmm! So the nose frame regenerated... at the mouth? Or is it a new frame surrounding the mouth-center region?
Looking at the image: at the mouth position, I can see a blue bar with a gray section and a charcoal square in the middle (where the nose core is). Yes! The image shows a charcoal frame around the nose core at the mouth center. So the nose frame followed the core! The frame regenerated around the core at the new position (rows 28-31, cols 32-35, core at rows 29-30, cols 33-34 inside it).
Interesting — so the frame regenerates around the core (the frame is attached to the core and re-forms after a delay or after the player moves away).
So the core is inside a frame at the mouth center.
- The mouth's blue is still split (left cols 28-31, right cols 36-39), and the gray is also split.
- Pink: c 7 [[63,57],[63,63]] — the pink bar is now 7px? Wait, that's the bottom-right corner piece (the black corner?). Actually, the P list from earlier: pink 59. The c 7 at row 63, cols 57-63 is the black corner (c=charcoal). The pink bar is probably 57 now.
Now, the body is at rows 32-35, cols 12-15, facing up. The left eye core is at rows 29-30, cols 17-18 — to the upper right of the body. To push the core to the right, the body needs to be at cols 12-15, rows 28-31 (the core's rows 29-30 must be within the body's rows). Currently the body is at rows 32-35 — the core's rows 29-30 are not within the body's rows 32-35. The body needs to be at rows 28-31: press UP → body rows 28-31? UP moves the body up by 4: rows 32-35 → 28-31. Then the body is at rows 28-31, cols 12-15, facing up. Then RIGHT → face right, blocked by the frame (cols 16-19, rows 28-31) → frame breaks. Then SPACE (arm extends right, cols 16-19, overlapping the core), then RIGHT×3 to push the core to cols 29-30.
Wait, but the body at rows 28-31, cols 12-15 — when pressing UP, does it move? The body is currently at rows 32-35; UP → rows 28-31, cols 12-15. Is there anything there? The left eye frame is at cols 16-19 — no overlap. OK.
So: UP, RIGHT, SPACE, RIGHT, RIGHT, RIGHT. Then check.

sections.label: ASSISTANT
sections.content:
World model: The body is at rows 32–35, cols 12–15, facing up; the left eye frame/core are intact. Notably, the nose frame has regenerated around the core at the center of the mouth (rows 28–31, cols 32–35) — the frame follows the core.
Plan: UP (align rows to 28–31), RIGHT (break the left eye frame), SPACE (extend arm over the core), RIGHT×3 (push the core to cols 29–30 inside the mouth).
